nodes.name: Factory UI Page (Toast State)
nodes.description: Factory UI screenshot showing the Task Factory page with a toast notification. Contains two-tab layout (Вопросы / Генерация), goal input field, and toast message overlay.

nodes.name: Toast Notification
nodes.description: A toast/notification overlay on the Factory UI. Possible messages: 'Сначала задайте вопросы на вкладке «Вопросы»' (info, when trying to switch to generation tab with no questions) or 'Укажите цель задачи' (error, when goal is empty). Displayed as a temporary floating message that auto-dismisses.

nodes.name: Tab: Вопросы (Questions Tab)
nodes.description: The active '❓ Вопросы' tab in the Factory UI two-tab navigation. Contains: goal input field (placeholder: 'Например: Создать калькулятор Fibonacci с проверкой чётности'), task count selector (1-3), steps per task selector (1-3), 'Задать вопросы' button, 'Посмотреть промпт' button.

nodes.name: Tab: Генерация (Generation Tab)
nodes.description: The '🏭 Генерация' tab in the Factory UI. Disabled (or attempted to switch to) when no questions exist — triggers the toast. Contains: goal summary display, answer inputs for LLM-generated clarifying questions, 'Сгенерить' button, prompt editor access.

nodes.name: Goal Input Field
nodes.description: Text input field for specifying the task goal. Placeholder: 'Например: Создать калькулятор Fibonacci с проверкой чётности'. Supports Enter key to trigger question generation. Validated on submit — empty value triggers error toast.

nodes.name: LLM Questions Prompt (questions prompt)
nodes.description: System prompt file for the question-generation LLM call. Instructs LLM to generate 3-5 clarifying questions about the user's goal: context, resources, verification needs, step granularity, manual vs automated steps, dependencies.

nodes.name: factory.js — Factory Page Controller
nodes.description: JavaScript controller for the Factory UI page. Manages two-tab state (questions/generation), goal input, question collection, LLM API calls (/generate/questions, /generate), prompt editor modal, fallback template generation. Toast notifications trigger on validation errors and success events.

metadata.state_fields: activeTab, goal, questions[], generated, resultFilename, promptsCache

hyperedges.name: Factory UI Toast Scenario
hyperedges.description: User interaction scenario: Factory UI displays a toast notification in response to validation failure — either empty goal submission (error toast) or attempting to access Generation tab without questions (info toast). The toast overlays the two-tab layout with goal input on the Questions tab.

relations.description: Factory UI page (controlled by factory.js) displays two tabs: Questions and Generation. User validation failure (empty goal or no-questions switch attempt) triggers app.toast() call in factory.js, showing a floating toast notification overlay on the page.

hyperedges.name: Factory LLM Question Generation Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Two-pass LLM pipeline visible in the Factory UI: (1) User enters goal in the input field → LLM generates 3-5 clarifying questions using the questions prompt → (2) User answers questions → LLM generates .kosmos.md file using the generator prompt.

relations.description: Goal from input → factory.js calls /generate/questions API with questions prompt → LLM returns clarifying questions → shown in Generation tab → answers collected → factory.js calls /generate API with generator prompt → outputs .kosmos.md file.

hyperedges.name: Factory Two-Tab Navigation with Guard
hyperedges.description: Two-tab navigation pattern in Factory UI with a conditional guard: 'Вопросы' tab always accessible (goal input + LLM question trigger), 'Генерация' tab has a guard that checks questions.length > 0 before allowing access — otherwise shows a toast notification as a soft block.

relations.description: Two-tabs: Questions (always active) and Generation (disabled when questions.length === 0). Guard in switchTab() checks questions count; if 0, shows info toast and blocks navigation. Badge counter shows question count on Generation tab when > 0.
